title: 第26章 穷得只能吃海鲜
novel_title: 七零老太随军，海岛养崽当家做主
content_zh:
和一辆车差不多长的大王椰树叶落在地上‘砰’的一声，距离不到半个身位的铁蛋也跌坐在不远处很是茫然。

    蔡老太有经验，立刻扯着孩子爸看天看地看空气。

    这时候要是和小孩眼神对上，包哭的！

    铁蛋发现没人看他，爬起来提了下裤头，小旋风似的跑了，甚至忽略了罪魁祸首。

    小孩忘性也是真大，过了一会就跟没事人一样继续去捡石头。

    第一趟小推车就收获满满，刚好赶上换班。

    井底的人上来以后，上边就把小推车里头的石头往井底下倒。

    第二批下井的人咬着手电筒马不停蹄开干。

    刚上井的稍微缓过劲跟着小推车又走了。

    全岛就十几个人，忙得脚后跟打脑壳，晚饭都是蔡老太领着儿媳妇烙饼，朝着每个铝饭盒里头撒一把紫菜碎，一把虾米，几滴酱油，一点点猪油冲了个酱油汤完事。

    这一干就没停下过，晚上哨所里还罕见地拉过来小型发电机点亮了汽灯。

    小孩可乐意大晚上在外头晃荡，压根就不想回家睡觉。

    赵玉兰喊了几回发现小孩装作没听见，再看婆婆也不催促，索性就闭上嘴。

    黑夜里终是传来惊喜的吆喝：

    “快快快，水涌上来了。”

    井底的人一惊呼，上方的人立刻铆足了劲将人往上提。

    第一个人上来了，第二个人很快也上来了。

    急速喷涌的水柱追着第三个人往上冲。

    最后一个人刚爬出井口，水柱也在井口一米的地方停住。

    大家争先恐后地趴着看，纷纷振臂高呼。

    “成功了！！！”

    “哗！！！！！”

    所有人抱在一起又跳又笑，笑着笑着又红了眼眶，你看看我，我看看你之后全都逼向蔡老太。

    又来！今儿都多少回了！

    小老太连忙往后退，却被一群小伙子举起来作势往上抛。

    魏建业关键时刻大喊一声：“放下我妈！”

    这群人真是乐颠了头，也不看看亲妈的年纪！

    他刚扶着惊魂未定的蔡老太，回头发现孩子们被当成吉祥物给抛来抛去。
content_en:
The giant coconut palm leaf, which was about the same length as a car, fell to the ground with a thud. Tie Dan, who was less than half a body away, also fell to the ground not far away, looking confused.

    Mrs. Cai had experience and immediately asked the father to look at the sky and the ground.

    If you make eye contact with a child at this time, you will definitely cry!

    Tiedan realized that no one was looking at him, so he got up, pulled up his trousers, and ran away like a whirlwind, even ignoring the culprit.

    Children are very forgetful. After a while, they continue to pick up stones as if nothing happened.

    The first trip to the trolley was fruitful, just in time for the shift change.

    After the people at the bottom of the well came up, the people above poured the stones from the cart down to the bottom of the well.

    The second group of people who went down the well held their flashlights in their hands and worked non-stop.

    The man who had just entered the well regained his composure and followed the cart away again.

    There are only a dozen people on the island, and they are so busy that they are beating their heads. For dinner, Mrs. Cai leads her daughter-in-law to bake pancakes, and then sprinkles a handful of shredded seaweed, a handful of dried shrimps, a few drops of soy sauce, and a little bit of lard into each aluminum lunch box to make a soy sauce soup.

    This work never stopped, and at night, a rare small generator was pulled over to the outpost to light up the gas lamps.

    Children are happy to hang out outside at night and don't even want to go home and sleep.

    Zhao Yulan shouted several times and found that the child pretended not to hear. She didn't urge her mother-in-law anymore, so she simply shut up.

    In the dark night, a surprising cry finally came:

    "Quick, quick, the water is coming up."

    As soon as the person at the bottom of the well shouted in surprise, the person above him immediately used all his strength to lift the person up.

    The first person came up, and the second person came up soon.

    The rapidly gushing water column chased the third person upward.

    As soon as the last person climbed out of the well, the water column stopped one meter away from the well.

    Everyone scrambled to lie down and watch, and raised their arms and shouted.

    "Success!!!"

    "Wow!!!!"

    Everyone hugged each other and jumped and laughed. They laughed and their eyes were red. You look at me, I look at you, and then they all pushed towards Mrs. Cai.

    Come again! How many times has it happened today!

    The little old lady quickly stepped back, but was picked up and thrown upward by a group of young men.

    At the critical moment, Wei Jianye shouted: "Put down my mother!"

    This group of people was so happy that they didn’t look at their mother’s age!

    He had just helped the frightened old lady Cai when he turned around and found that the children were being thrown around as mascots.
title_en: Chapter 26 Too poor to eat only seafood
